partition.partition_key: one FULL178 row per durable unit
partition.assignment: Use the existing source-locked deterministic partition with shard_count=178. Since there are exactly 178 FULL178 rows, every shard receives exactly one row.
partition.expected_coverage: All 178 FULL178 rows exactly once; each row contains every historical b-shard cell exactly once.
partition.certificate: One compact canonical JSON certificate per completed FULL178 row.
partition.union_verification: Reconstruct the source-locked deterministic partition; require row units 0..177 exactly once; reject row gaps/overlaps/source-lock drift; sum exact Fraction objectives and cellwise integer floors; reconstruct diagnostic stream in original row/b-shard order.

carry_over.reuse_rule: Download the same-index one-row certificate from carry_run_id; reuse only when canonical digest, producer blob, worker blob, shard index/count and assignment digest validate under the current locked worker.
carry_over.missing_or_rejected_rule: Compute only the missing or rejected row. A validated completed row is never recomputed merely because another row timed out or the workflow was cancelled.
carry_over.cross_generation_requirement: Producer, worker, partition algorithm and shard_count=178 must remain byte/semantically locked. Drift invalidates incompatible carry-over rather than silently reusing it.

cancellation_recovery.completed_units: Each completed row uploads its compact certificate immediately when that row job completes.
cancellation_recovery.cancelled_or_timed_out_units: No completion is inferred for the currently running row. Re-arm a fresh runkey generation with carry_run_id set to the cancelled/failed run; validate and salvage every completed row artifact, then compute only missing/rejected rows.

progress.format: HPADJ20_SHARD_PROGRESS shard=i/178 row=1/1 row_id=... d=... elapsed_s=... eta_s=0.0

storage_preflight.cleanup_point: Row artifacts expire after one day; only the compact final union certificate is retained for the audit window.
storage_preflight.stop_condition: Fail before upload if any row certificate exceeds 1,000,000 bytes or the final union certificate exceeds 2,000,000 bytes. No raw search state is uploaded.

authorization.automatic_event: pull_request synchronize/opened only when the dedicated runkey path changed in the triggering range
authorization.workflow_dispatch_after_default_branch_i: Exact-head manual rerun remains available, still source/runkey locked.
